description: Hand-written 30-second call: the prospect is hostile from the start and the call ends with permission for one email.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Hi, is this Jordan? This is Sam from Brightline, calling about the no-shows at your clinic.

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: How did you get this number?

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: It's listed on your website. I'll be quick: could I have thirty seconds to explain why I called?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: No. I get five of these calls a day. We're not interested, take me off your list.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: Understood, you get a lot of these. Would it be okay if I sent one email instead?

segments.speaker: them
segments.text: Fine, whatever. Just don't call again.

segments.speaker: you
segments.text: I won't. Thanks for your time, Jordan.
